title: Global sections of a depth-two punctured local spectrum
statement: Let R be a Noetherian commutative local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] of depth at least two [def-weil-pbc-depth]. Let W be the open in Spec R consisting exactly of the points other than the closed point [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. The canonical restriction Gamma(Spec R,O) to Gamma(W,O) is bijective.

source.place: Tags 0AVY, 0BK0 and 0E9I; structure-module specialization of depth-two Hartogs restriction.

proof.text: Take the unit sheaf of modules on Spec R. It is quasi-coherent and has finite free rank-one sections on each affine open. Its stalk is linearly equivalent to the structure-sheaf stalk, using preservation of the stalk colimit by the forgetful functor.

The only boundary point is the closed point, whose structure-sheaf stalk is ring-isomorphic to R. Transport regular sequences through this ring equivalence and the preceding linear equivalence to get a finite module stalk of depth at least two.

Apply depth-two Hartogs restriction to the unit module. Its restriction-adjunction unit is an isomorphism. The component on the top open is canonical restriction on structure-sheaf sections; ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso proves the claim.
